# gitignore-worktree-debugging skill

Qwen skill for worktree debugging and gitignore hygiene.

## Purpose

- Troubleshoot `.gitignore` and worktree contamination issues.

## Ownership

- Local-router operations.

## Local Contracts

- Do not commit worktree artifacts into the main repository.

## Work Guidance

- Use when worktrees show unexpected files or gitignore gaps.

## Verification

- Run `git status` clean after applying fixes.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
